title: Amazon E-commerce: Complete Design
description: Design amazon e-commerce with OOP principles, class diagrams, and scalable C# implementations.

data.text: Design a amazon e-commerce using object-oriented principles. Focus on clean class design, proper encapsulation, and extensible architecture.

data.caption: Class diagram for Amazon E-commerce. Each class encapsulates domain logic and collaborates through well-defined interfaces.

data.caption: Interaction flow for Amazon E-commerce. Shows how components collaborate to fulfill a user request.
data.definition:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant S as AmazonECommerceService
    participant US as User
    participant PR as Product
    participant CA as Cart
    participant OR as Order

    C->>S: Request
    S->>PR: AddToCart()
    PR-->>S: Result
    S->>CA: Checkout()
    CA-->>S: Result
    S->>OR: ProcessOrder()
    OR-->>S: Result
    S->>OR: Pay()
    OR-->>S: Result
    S-->>C: Response

data.title: amazon-ecommerce.Advanced.cs — Processor Pipeline
Design Principles Applied
data.text: Use composition over inheritance. Keep entities simple. Use interfaces to decouple services from implementations. Apply CQRS when read and write patterns diverge.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Encapsulate state inside entities; expose behavior, not data
Strategy and Command patterns make behavior pluggable
Dependency injection keeps classes loosely coupled
data.takeaway: Amazon E-commerce demonstrates how clean OOP design leads to maintainable, testable code that can evolve with requirements.
